facts.fact: 日记日期 2024-10-20，开头写天气转好、散步看见鹿
facts.anchor: Better weather this week. I saw some deer on my walk today.

facts.fact: 他放下笔想起 Arthur 的日记，「鹿是好动物」是句古怪的话
facts.anchor: He put down the pen, remembering Arthur’s journal. Deer are good animals. What an odd phrase.

facts.fact: 自 10-17（ch15）狗叫那日后没有新网球出现
facts.anchor: No more tennis balls had appeared since the day of the barking dog.

facts.fact: 他开车去 Lyke 买深红天鹅绒窗帘，像童年电影院座椅，把窗户完全遮住
facts.anchor: And he had driven into Lyke and bought some living-room curtains; they were a dark-red velvet, like the cinema seats of his childhood

facts.fact: 「Fire, fleet and candle-light」谐音梗，引出 Lucy 说过的小屋原名 Firefleet
facts.anchor: That was all he needed, he thought. Fire, fleet and candle-light. For a moment he wondered at the phrase, then he remembered what Lucy had said. The original name was Firefleet.

facts.fact: 他弃 Kirkhill 取 Firefleet：前者冷、清教、像没有窗帘的房子
facts.anchor: And he liked it better than Kirkhill, which sounded cold and Protestant, the name of a house with no curtains.

facts.fact: Caroline 死在雪里，却仍在书、日记、摆设与门厅靴子里在场
facts.anchor: He knew that wasn’t possible: Caroline was dead in the snow. And yet, she was present; in her books; her diaries; her ornaments; in her boots in the hallway.

facts.fact: 当晚他从头做蘑菇意饭、摆两副餐具；结尾对空椅说「生日快乐，Caroline……我记得」——她生日是 10-20（ch18 有载），而 Arthur 在 ch02 日记里忘了她的生日（「My birthday. He forgot again.」）
facts.anchor: That evening he cooked dinner from scratch. No more bachelor food, he thought; he needed to stay healthy. He made a mushroom risotto from a cookery book he found on the shelves, and set two places for dinner.
